messages:
Anna G: Heads-up — launching a webinar in 3 weeks (Nov 20). Proposal: tight search + retargeting funnel, refresh creatives on day 4, and explicit inbound lead routing to webinar SDR queue. Need rapid sign-off on budget split and tracking.
Diego P: Love it. Suggest initial budget $2.5k/day for first 5 days to build signal, then taper to $1.2k/day with a weekend cap. Split: 60% search (branded + high-intent non-branded), 40% retarget (site visitors + engaged demo viewers).
Kate L: For search, can we prioritize long-tail purchase-intent keywords and pull back on broad match? Want CPA target <$65 first 14 days. Also set negative list for competitor terms and free-tier keywords.
Tom A: Creative plan: 3 headlines x 2 descriptions = 6 ad variants for search. For retargeting: carousel with 4 frames (webinar value props, speaker creds, CTA, testimonial). Refresh creative on day 4 and day 10. Keep one control creative throughout for A/B.
Anna G: Tracking & UTMs — canonical UTM pattern below. Please use exactly so analytics, ads, and CRM align.
Tom A: ```utm_source=google&utm_medium=paid_search&utm_campaign=webinar_nov20&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={creative_variant}```
Diego P: Also enable view-through conversions for retargeting. Set campaign-level conversion window to 7d view / 1d click for the webinar signups.
Rebecca C: Inbound routing — send all webinar leads to HubSpot list "Webinar Nov20 - Paid" and fanout via Zapier: high-intent (lead score >40) -> SDR queue, rest -> nurturing drip with 3 emails. Zap mapping:
Rebecca C: ```Zap: New Contact -> Filter: utm_campaign==webinar_nov20 -> Create Deal + Assign Owner based on lead_score -> Add to HubSpot List``` 
Zapier Bot: Zap "webinar_paid_fanout" last run: success 2m ago. Tests passed.
Diego P: Quick ask for ops — can Eng set an event for demo-video play >=30s so we can retarget viewers with the 30s-specific creative? That would really boost signal.
Anna G: Good call. @Tom A, @Rebecca C — can you finalize ad copy + landing page variants by EOD Wednesday so I can send to legal and ops for pixel placement?
Tom A: Yup, I'll drop a copy deck in this thread by tomorrow noon.
Kate L: I'll prepare the initial keyword list and negative list and post it here for review.
Rebecca C: I'll draft the Zap and HubSpot workflow and share test instructions.
Anna G: Cool — action items: Tom (copy deck), Kate (keywords), Rebecca (Zap + workflow), Diego (campaign draft + budgets). I'll consolidate and loop in legal/ads-ops on Thursday. :rocket:
Diego P: :thumbsup: will also add dayparting to prioritize mornings and early-afternoon for webinar sign-ups.
Tom A: :eyes: adding one control with original creative to measure lift vs refreshed ones.
Anna G: Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks. We'll sync again Friday morning for a pre-launch dry run."
